purpose: Preserve the fast previous-day liquidity sweep/reclaim timing while testing lightweight completed-S5 rejection quality that does not add a multi-stage delay.

source_basis.logic: Exact PDH+PDL S5 reclaim strong-passed Stage-A but failed Jan-Jul robustness; keep prior-day anchor and timing, do not side/month split.
Public reconstructible sweep logic distinguishes wick and dual-candle sweeps and uses an engulfing recovery candle as additional confirmation.

source_basis.source: MQL5 Liquidity Sweep with MA Filter
source_basis.logic: Completed-bar liquidity sweep detection uses close-back-inside plus candle color-change/reversal behavior.
Liquidity sweep failure is defined causally by temporary level violation followed by completed close back inside; structural validity emphasizes reaction quality rather than dense indicators.

frozen_base.levels: previous active UTC-day P75 Bid high and low, both retained
frozen_base.sweep: first strict tick beyond fixed PDH/PDL
frozen_base.reclaim: first completed S5 bar closing back inside swept level within same UTC day
frozen_base.ownership: one event per PDH/PDL level/day; no rearm
frozen_base.decision: first executable tick at/after reclaim edge; reclaim must still hold; <=25-point spread
frozen_base.lifecycle: 0.01 lot; $0.30 stop; +$0.10 trail activation; $0.03 trail distance; 30s max hold; $0.02 round-trip commission

configs.C01_DIRECTIONAL_RECLAIM: Require reclaim S5 candle bearish for PDH / bullish for PDL.
configs.C02_REVERSAL_HALF_CLOSE: Require reclaim close in reversal-direction half of its own S5 high-low range.
configs.C03_ENGULFING_RECOVERY: Require reversal-direction reclaim candle to body-engulf immediately previous completed S5 candle.
configs.C04_DIRECTIONAL_RANGE_EXPANSION: Require directional reclaim candle and reclaim high-low range > immediately previous S5 range.

comparative_gate.baseline: Exact source-only PLSR C01 on same files and execution
